Let's compute precisely: 3.5952e10 / 9 = 3.995999...e9? Actually 3.5952e10 / 9 = 3.995999...e9. So about 3.996e9 N/C.

Now magnetic field inside solenoid: B = μ0 * n * I. μ0 = 4π × 10^-7 H/m. n = turns per meter = 25. I = 0.5 A. So B = 4π×10^-7 * 25 * 0.5 = 4π×10^-7 * 12.5 = 50π×10^-7? Wait 4π×10^-7 * 12.5 = (4*12.5)π×10^-7 = 50π×10^-7 = 5π×10^-6? Because 50π×10^-7 = 5π×10^-6. π ≈ 3.1416, so 5π ≈ 15.708. So B ≈ 15.708×10^-6 T = 1.5708e-5 T. So about 1.57e-5 Tesla.

Length of solenoid doesn't affect B inside ideal solenoid. So we can mention that.
